name: Bacon Cheeseburger
steps: Create chili mayo by mixing together mayonnaise, siracha, honey, and lemon juice in a small bowl.
Add butter to a pan and heat it up.
Add the buns to the pan and toast them until golden brown.
Start building the burger by adding the lettuce on the bottom, and the chili mayo on the top bun.
Add the beef patty to the pan and cook it through. Toast the bacon at the same time if there is room in the pan.
After flipping the beef patty, add the cheese on top and let it melt.
Assemble the burger by adding the beef patty with melted cheese on top of the lettuce, and then add the bacon on top of the beef patty.
Place the top bun with chili mayo on top of the bacon and serve.
